messages:
Claire B: Quick one — Prospect NimbusClinic needs SOC2 redacted copy, ISO snippet, and a signed external-scan authorization. Their vendor will perform authenticated scans against staging and may request a 12h dedicated warm window. Also asked for ephemeral creds (S3 presign + short-lived SSH). Who signs and rough ops cost?

Omar V: Legal (GC) signs our standard pen-test auth. Security provides approved scope. We never hand out persistent host creds or raw syslogs. If they want a dedicated warm pool, that’s billable.

Sophie L: Ops pattern: presigned S3 for artifact exchange + timeboxed SSH via jumpbox tokens. VPN instead of IP allowlist adds ~1 business day. If vendor requires continuous monitoring during scan, add on-call fee.

Raj P: Ballpark pricing for 12h on 4x A100: ~ $2.6k infra + ~$500 ops = ~$3.1k total (very rough). If they shorten to 6h it's ~60% of that. Exact quote from capacity team.

Infra Bot: Pre-signed upload ready: https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/presign/nimbus-2951234567 (expires in 48h). Upload vendor scope, vendor COI, and IP list to /nimbus/vendor-scan/.

Claire B: Action items: 1) Sophie to draft signature-ready attestation with SLA line isolating scan window. 2) Raj to confirm final estimate with capacity. 3) Prospect to upload vendor COI + scope to presign link. 4) Infra Bot to provision creds after approvals.

Omar V: Suggested attestation clause: "Testing will be limited to the mutually agreed scope and timeframe; Redwood Inference is not liable for findings outside the agreed scope." If buyer asks to increase liability limits, escalate for exec review.

Sophie L: Noted — I'll prep the attestation and send to legal. Claire, once the customer uploads scope & IPs tag me and I'll schedule ops.

Claire B: Thanks — I'll pass the presigned link and preliminary ~$3.1k estimate to Nimbus and ask them to upload vendor docs. Will loop back when they upload. :thumbsup:
